preconditions.description: The number of skewers n is between 1 and 200,000 inclusive.

preconditions.expression: len(p) == n and all(1 <= x <= n for x in p)
preconditions.description: The permutation p is a list of length n containing integers from 1 to n.

preconditions.expression: len(b) == n and all(x in {0, 1} for x in b)
preconditions.description: The sequence b is a list of length n containing only 0s and 1s.

postconditions.description: The minimum number of changes needed is between 0 and 2n inclusive.
The return value represents the minimum number of changes needed to make the permutation p and sequence b such that each skewer visits each of 2n placements.
